description: Pocket2D local agent gameplay protocol. One JSON request object per line on stdin, one response per line on stdout. The same commands are exposed as MCP tools. Parameter schemas are JSON Schema 2020-12; the runtime validates every request itself and reports invalid_request or a command-specific error.

keys.description: Complete held key set as SDL key names (for example "right", "space", "e"). Omit to keep the previous held keys; [] releases all keys. Edges occur once at the start of the request.

mouse.description: Screen-space mouse state. Omitted x/y/buttons are retained; buttons is the complete held set (1 left, 2 middle, 3 right); wheel applies on the first tick only.

actor_ref.description: An actor UID as a decimal string, or an actor name (the lowest UID with that name).

anyOf.description: Stops when gameplay publishes an EventBus event of this type.
Stops when an actor property compares true. Without component, property is x, y or rotation of the actor's world position. A missing actor, component or property compares false.
Stops when the named actor exists (true) or no longer exists (false).

actor_uid.description: Decimal UID string (preferred) or unsigned integer.

commands.name: describe
commands.summary: Report the protocol version, command schemas, execution limits, registered component types and the curated Lua host API.

commands.name: observe
commands.summary: Return the current frame, scene, running state and every live actor with world position and supported component properties, without advancing time. Optional bounded tilemap cell queries.

tilemaps.description: At most 16 queries and 256 cells in total.

commands.name: step
commands.summary: Advance fixed 1/60 s ticks with the given held input, then observe.

commands.name: run_until
commands.summary: Advance ticks with the given held input until any condition holds after a tick, gameplay stops, or max_frames elapse, then observe. The response's run_until reports the reason, frames advanced and matched condition index.

commands.name: reload_scripts
commands.summary: Atomically reload the source files of registered Lua component types at idle, keeping instances and state; does not advance a tick or rerun OnStart.

commands.name: reset
commands.summary: Start a new runtime worker and reload the project, applying the seed before any script runs. Omitting seed keeps the current one.

commands.name: quit
commands.summary: Stop the runtime and end the session.
